guardrailItems: Ba ya kirkirar nassoshin Littafi Mai Tsarki.
Yana karfafa neman shawara a manyan zabi.
askIntro: Fara da tambaya ta gaskiya. Aletheia za ta rage gaggawa ta taimaka maka fahimta.
modeGuidancePreview: Ka wannan kallo ya kasance mai sauki. Bude shi idan kana son bincike mai zurfi, abubuwan da ka iya boye, da alamun balaga.
greetingIntent: Mu zabi mataki na hikima na gaba yau.
whatNextBody: Aletheia tana zaɓar aiki na hikima da farko. Filin tambaya da sarrafa yanayi suna a ƙasa lokacin da kuke son fara sabon abu.
askOneQuestionBody: Fara da matsin lamba ko shawarar da kuke ɗauka a yanzu.
askNewQuestionBody: Filin Companion da salon hikima suna a ƙasa.
notificationPromptBody: Karɓi ƙarfafawa na hikima na yau da kullun a hankali.
syncDevicesBody: Ajiye shawara da tunani a dukkan na'urori.
startDecisionBody: Bi zaɓi mai mahimmanci a lokaci.
modeShapesCounsel: yana tsara wannan shawarar dangane da
shareAnswerPrompt: Raba Aletheia da wanda zai iya amfana da irin wannan shawarar.
sharePrivacyNote: Wannan yana raba mahaɗin app kawai, ba tambayar ku ko amsar sirri ta Aletheia ba.
waitingModeUsed: An yi amfani da yanayin jira
formationNote: Waɗannan alamomi ne na hankali na tsarawa, ba maki da za a bi ba. Alamar farko yawanci tana farawa da adana tunani ɗaya.
milestoneShareTitle: Kun san wanda ke yin muhimmiyar shawara?
milestoneShareBody: Kuna iya gayyatonsu zuwa Aletheia ba tare da raba wani abu mai sirri daga asusunku ba.
welcomeCounsel: Kawo shawara ta gaske, matsin lamba ko tambayar kuɗi. Zan amsa daga ɗakin karatu na hikima da aka tsara, tare da fayyace motsin rai kuma ba tare da alkawuran kuɗi ba.
trustScriptureBody: Nassoshi na Littafi Mai Tsarki sun fito ne daga ɗakin karatu na hikima na Aletheia. Idan aya ta bayyana, zaku iya danna ta don ganin mahallin da dalilin da ya sa yake da muhimmanci.
trustBoundaryBody: Aletheia ba zai yi alkawarin sakamako ba, ba zai yi hasashen kasuwanni ba, ba zai yi iƙirarin tabbacin Allah ba, ko kuma ya maye gurbin shawara ta ƙwararru na kuɗi, doka, haraji, likita ko na limamin coci.
trustMemoryBody: Ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya da aka haɗa tana taimakawa daidaituwa tsakanin shawara, tunani, shawara da ƙa'idodin rayuwa. Ya kamata ya sanya jagora ta zama ta sirri fiye ba tare da fallasa cikakkun bayanai na sirri ba tare da buƙata ba.
trustConnectedDataBody: Haɗin lafiya, kuɗi ko na'ura na gaba yakamata su kasance izini-zuwa-izini, kashe a tsohuwa kuma iyakance ga ainihin bayanan da mai amfani ya zaɓa don haɗawa.

money.label: Kuɗi
money.intent: Kula da albarkatu tare da zaman lafiya da bayyanawa.
money.focus: Kasafin kuɗi, bashi, ajiya, saka hannun jari, gamsuwa
money.useWhen: Yi amfani don kashe kuɗi, bashi, ajiya, saka hannun jari, damuwar kuɗi, ko kwatanta.
prompts: Yaya zan gina dukiya ba tare da kwadayi ba?
Me hikima ke cewa game da bashi?
Yaya zan daina kwatanta kaina ta hanyar kuɗi?

work.label: Aiki
work.intent: Gane aiki, kira, jagoranci, da buri mai dorewa.
work.focus: Canje-canjen sana'a, jagoranci, kasuwanci, gajiya, kira
work.useWhen: Yi amfani don yanke shawarar aiki, ra'ayoyin kasuwanci, matsin jagoranci, gajiya, ko buri.
prompts: Shin ya kamata in bar aikin da na tsaya da ƙarfi?
Ta yaya zan san ko burina yana da lafiya?
Shin ya kamata in fara wannan kasuwancin yanzu?

purpose.label: Manufa
purpose.intent: Rage saurin kuma gane mutumin da wannan shawarar ke tsarawa.
purpose.focus: Ainihi, alkibla, damuwa, dabi'u, bayyananwa na dogon lokaci
purpose.useWhen: Yi amfani lokacin da tambayar ainihi ta kasance ainihi, alkibla, zaman lafiya, lokaci, ko dabi'u.
prompts: Yaya zan yi shawara lokacin da na ji ban sani ba?
Idan ina bin nasara saboda dalilin da ba daidai ba?
Yaya zan sami zaman lafiya game da matakin na na gaba?

generosity.label: Karimci
generosity.intent: Bayarwa cikin 'yanci ba tare da laifi, matsin lamba, ko nuna ba.
generosity.focus: Bayarwa, tallafin iyali, sadaka, iyaka, dorewa
generosity.useWhen: Yi amfani don bayarwa, zaka, taimakawa iyali, iyaka, ko karimci mai dorewa.
prompts: Yaya zan bayar ba tare da laifi ko matsin lamba ba?
Shin ya kamata in sake taimakawa iyalina da kuɗi?
Nawa karimci ya dace da ni?
